title: Log Viewer
summary: An operations tool shows log files by name. It may be able to show more than logs.
objectives: Read the provided logs for clues
learningOutcomes: Recognise path traversal in file parameters
Confine file access to an allowed directory

hints.bodyMd: Read app.log carefully. It mentions a settings file and where it lives relative to the logs.
The file parameter is joined onto the logs directory. What does `..` do to a path?
